LSE 0.6.0: long-context decode is faster, with chains and draft trees on one WMMA flash split and a draft policy that prices each context length.

- macOS: needs mac_linuxgpu build 266 or later; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.
- Linux: needs the amdgpu kernel driver with KFD and access to `/dev/kfd`; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.

## Performance

Prefill, tok/s:

| GPU | OS | 256 | 1K | 2K | 4K | 32K |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) | Linux | 463 | 499 | 512 | 522 | 480 |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | iPadOS (LemonSeed Studio) | Results pending | | | | |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | Linux | 1,155 | 1,424 | 1,463 | 1,501 | 1,394 |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | macOS | 1,393 | 1,489 | 1,536 | 1,666 | 1,563 |

Decode, code prompt, tok/s:

| GPU | OS | Baseline | dMTP | DFlash2 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) | Linux | 14.1 | 46.2 | **63.2** |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | iPadOS (LemonSeed Studio) | Results pending | | |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | Linux | 32.5 | 114.3 | **140.1** |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | macOS | 33.1 | 125.2 | **164.0** |

Model: Qwen3.8-27B, 4-bit (MLX); drafts: dMTP (dynamic MTP) 8-bit, DFlash2 8-bit.

## Changes

- Context-aware draft policy: dMTP and DFlash2 keep verify and draft costs per context length, and recover from a cold first request.
- Long-context attention: chains and draft trees run on one WMMA flash split, K/V are read once per kv-head, and the V cache is stored fragment-ready.
- DFlash2 at long context on the R9700, code task: 130 tok/s at 64K and 112 at 128K on Linux, 141 and 108 on macOS.
- dMTP at long context is faster: 87 tok/s at 64K and 71 at 128K on the Linux R9700, 96 and 78 on macOS.
- Chain-pass greedy output can differ from 0.5.9 in the last bits; perplexity is unchanged at 7.1467.
